title: A Custom graph node emits MIDI through its event block's out buffer

needles: `out` is the node's own MIDI output buffer
emitted events do not leak into a later block
Translated routing binder resolves an emitting event-aware custom node

installed_sdk.rationale: custom_node_events.hpp is installed by the per-subsystem header loop in tools/cmake/PulpInstallRules.cmake, which appends `host` whenever the pulp-host target exists and installs the tree FILES_MATCHING "*.hpp". The emission lane adds no new symbol: the field an SDK consumer writes is CustomNodeEventBlock::out, which that header already declared and installed, so what this slice delivers to an installed consumer is the field becoming non-null at run time plus the contract documented on it. Measured against that install loop rather than assumed.

needles: nullable on exactly the same terms as `in`

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler changes. A Custom node type is registered from C++ against a SignalGraph; the offline timeline CLI neither registers node types nor reaches this callback, so there is nothing for it to expose.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler changes, for the same reason as the CLI: no MCP surface registers a CustomNodeType.

live_product_control.rationale: A musician cannot reach this, and the blocker is inherited rather than introduced here. Emission is an authoring capability for code that builds a graph; the route that would put it in a product is the Forge CustomNodeType pack, which requires a lowerable entry because packs register before bake(), while registration refuses a lowerable event-aware type and the baked binder carries no event binder at all. So the bake layer needs an event plane before a pack entry is expressible — the same first dependency the inbound lane recorded.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: An agent reading the installed capability manifest cannot discover emission. Measured, not assumed: agent_capability_manifest.py --check passes on this base over 112 keys and 499 public headers, and custom_node_events.hpp appears in none of them — core/host/include/pulp/host is not a PUBLIC_ROOT, so a host header is fingerprinted only when named in the host-header tuple, and the control confirms the instrument is live (custom_node_type.hpp IS catalog-bound there). The emission contract therefore reaches an agent only once that header is tracked and a capability key describes the lane; both are surface-policy decisions this slice does not take.
